name: Joshi no Oshikko Ijime ~Joshiben-kun to Iwareta Boku no 6 Nenkan~
original_name: 女子のおしっこいじめ ～女子便くんといわれたボクの6年間～
source:
One day in early summer, the protagonist finds used sanitary napkins stuffed in his slippers.
Four girls appear in front of the confused protagonist. Saori, Mami, Youko, and Yuuko.
A group of bullies at the center of the class.
They force the protagonist to lick the used napkins. It is the first time he licks something that was in close contact with a girl's private parts before.

After that, they start to bully the protagonist. They make him swallow their drool in the classroom, and pee in the girl's toilet.
What's more, they give him the nickname "Girl's Toilet". He has to lick the panties of all girls in the class, the bullies pour pee on him,
he has to swallow it, and the pee-rich bullying continues...
translation:
初夏的一天，主角发现拖鞋里塞着用过的卫生巾。
四名女孩出现在困惑的主角面前：沙织、麻美、洋子和优子。
她们是班级中心的霸凌团体。
她们强迫主角舔用过的卫生巾。这是他第一次舔舐曾紧贴女孩私处的东西。

从那以后，她们开始欺负主角。她们让他在教室里吞下自己的口水，还让他在女厕所里小便。
不仅如此，她们还给他起了“女厕所”的绰号。他必须舔班里所有女孩的内裤，霸凌者把尿浇在他身上，
他不得不吞下去，而充满尿液的霸凌仍在继续……
